A '''gravitic sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] linked to a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Gravitic sensors scanned for [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]] while in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and if one was detected close to the vessel, it could cut out the hyperdrive to stop the ship from colliding with the object.<ref name="RPG" />
